qualitative.gate_2_reason: Addictive, socially destructive tobacco business model facing terminal volume decline, severe legislative/regulatory bans, and punitive excise taxation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Addictive and predatory tobacco business model explicitly disqualified under Gate 2 due to severe legislative, societal, and regulatory ruin risk, persistent combustible volume declines, and aggressive excise taxation.
qualitative.evidence: Global tobacco manufacturer with brands including Lucky Strike, Dunhill, Kent, and Newport. While traditional pricing power has historically offset mid-single-digit combustible volume declines, the sector faces terminal societal headwinds, illicit vape competition, UK generational smoking bans, US menthol flavor bans, and massive goodwill impairments (£27B write-down on US cigarette brands in 2023).
